sections.title: Masters Proseminar in International Educational Development
sections.description: This course covers the broad professional arena of international educational development. It is designed to provide an analytical perspective on applied research and policy as undertaken by UN, donor and non-profit agencies, with a focus on developing countries. Such work will require analyzing intellectual and technical challenges of working in international education and human development, especially around issues of social and public policy as developed through writing policy briefs. Several specialists and speakers will be invited as guests throughout the semester.
